degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor's degree in Engineering

description.text: Teaching Objective The major is aimed to train chemical engineers to master the basic knowledge and related knowledge of chemical engineering and technology, the ability of analyzing and solving problems with the knowledge, the ability to adapting the society and international communication skills. Main Course Advanced Mathematics, Inorganic Chemistry, College Physics, Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Introduction of Chemical Engineering & Pharmacy, Probability and Statistics, Basic Chemistry(Analysis), Electrical Engineering, Principle of Chemical Engineering, Basis of Chemical Instrument, etc. Internship and Career The school has cooperated with many famous companies including Sinopec Group, China National Petroleum Corporation, China Chemical Group and China Sinochem Group etc. Every school students have the opportunity to make internship in these companies.Sinopec Group Each year the school sends 15-25 students to those appointed company to make practice or graduation project for 1 year. Degree Awarded Bachelor's degree in Engineering School of Chemical Engineering

duration.text: The Chemical Engineering and Technology at Dalian University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3541 USD/per year ￥ 25500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (Optional)

requirements.text: The applicants must 1. Hold a high school diploma 2. Be in good health and over the age of 18, with a Chinese proficiency level of HSK5 or above (for art students HSK6 or above).
